compos.summarization:
The smartphone UI screen displays the "Audible Service Terms of Use" page. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Header**: 
   - URL: "https://mobile.audible.com/help"
   - Audible logo
   - Menu icon (three horizontal lines)
   - Search icon (magnifying glass)

2. **Title**: "Audible Service Terms of Use"
   - Last updated: June 7, 2016

3. **Content**:
   - Introduction: Agreement between the user and Audible, Inc. regarding the digital spoken word audio entertainment service.
   - Reference to Amazon.com Conditions of Use and Privacy Notice.
   - Terms: Explanation that the terms govern the use of the service and take precedence over conflicting provisions.
   - User Agreement: By signing up or using the service, the user agrees to the terms.
   - Account Information: Requirement to establish an Audible or Amazon.com account to use the service, with payment
